$comment: /workshops/ — Learn, the owner page for workshops: what they are, what's coming up (from content/events, decided by the clock), what they're like, and the one action, the account. Most of the words are the home page's Learn scenes, said in one place.

meta.need: As someone who wants to learn something useful soon, I need to know what the workshops are, when the next ones are and what they ask of me, so that I can come to one.

title: Workshops
description: Free, hands-on workshops at your local public library, and some online, on the skills that matter at work right now. No application, no experience needed. Anyone can come.

hero.title: Get sharp, in good company.
hero.lede: Free workshops at your local public library, and some online, on the skills that matter at work right now. No application, no experience needed. Anyone can come.

coming.title: Pick one and come along.
coming.empty: Nothing is on the calendar right now. Join, and you'll hear the moment the next one is.

like.title: Hands-on, with people at every level.

items.title: Skills that last
items.body: Communicating, telling a story, framing a problem well.

items.title: Using AI well
items.body: What the tools can and can't do, getting good answers, and building simple apps and agents.

items.title: Made by the people here
items.body: Mentors build each workshop around what a team ran into. What works is kept and shared with every Lab.

steps.title: Make your free account
steps.body: It takes a minute, and it shows you what's on near you.

steps.title: Pick a session
steps.body: Save your seat from your account. Nothing to apply for.

steps.title: Come along
steps.body: Bring a laptop if you have one. The people there will help with the rest.

items.title: No lectures.
items.body: You'll do the thing, with help beside you.

items.title: No experience needed.
items.body: Every session starts from where the room is.

items.title: Free, always.
items.body: Nothing to buy, now or later.

items.title: It leads somewhere.
items.body: Workshops are where most people start, and where Mentors do too.

join.title: Come to one this week.
join.lede: Make your free account, and you'll see what's on near you.
join.next: Then: a workshop, or the next Build Cycle.
